item: the app refuses every request until its own startup checked the loop and armed the airplane guard
summary: A server started with uvicorn --lifespan off, or the app mounted inside another ASGI app, runs no lifespan, so it skipped R642's loop check and the airplane guard. A first-request middleware (_serving_gate) now answers 503 in fixed words until the lifespan's loop check ran and the guard is armed; the lifespan arms the guard before the first request (a locked store's unlock flow included). Waived only where the boot never arms it: OO_AIRPLANE_SOCKET_GUARD=0 (guard half) and OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1 (both). The audit recipes now pass --loop asyncio. Release line: if the app is started in a way that skips its own startup, it now refuses to serve and says to use its own launcher, instead of running without airplane mode's network guard.
